envelope.reason: live assay: --agent mav ran as mav but did not preload design, plan, deliver or note

payload.gloss: running a harness's main session as a projected persona, with the persona's identity as its system prompt and its composed skills loaded before the first turn, exactly as a dispatched holder of the same position receives them. omp reaches it through the generated launcher; Claude Code through claude --agent, which applies the identity but preloads skills only for subagents, so the projection must carry the skills into the main session itself.
